title: Large Signal Libraries: Equal-Weight Limits and the Divergent Spectra of Signals and PnL
abstract: arXiv:2609.12477v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: An ensemble of roughly 3,000 signals over 20 assets was reported to have approximately 90% correlation with the leading component of the asset-space return structure. Does having about 158 signals per available linear dimension explain that alignment? The population answer depends on the research process's design distribution and its relation to returns: crowding alone imposes neither a nonzero mean nor agreement with a principal component. The population theory developed here distinguishes four objects: the equal-weight signal, signal principal components, equal-weight profit and loss (PnL), and PnL principal components. The return operator in the motivating observation is a separate object. Independent libraries converge to their design mean; exchangeable libraries can retain a random conditional mean. translated_title: 大型信号库：等权极限与信号与损益的发散谱
translated_abstract: 据报告，一个由约3,000个信号组成的集合在20种资产上与资产空间收益结构的主导成分具有约90%的相关性。每个可用线性维度拥有约158个信号是否能解释这种一致性？总体层面的答案取决于研究过程的设计分布及其与收益的关系：拥挤本身既不会产生非零均值，也不会与主成分达成一致。本文发展的总体理论区分了四个对象：等权信号、信号主成分、等权损益（PnL）以及损益主成分。驱动上述观察的收益算子是另一个独立的对象。独立的信号库收敛于其设计均值；可交换的信号库则可以保留一个随机条件均值。跨d种资产的横截面信号在去均值和归一化后，位于q维空间的单位球面S^{q-1}上，q=...
tldr: 本文建立总体理论框架，区分等权信号、信号主成分、等权损益与损益主成分四个对象，证明信号库的拥挤本身既不会带来非零均值也不会与收益主成分一致，这种一致性取决于研究过程的设计分布及其与收益的关系。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a population theory distinguishing four objects—equal-weight signals, signal principal components, equal-weight PnL, and PnL principal components—showing that crowding in a signal library alone imposes neither a nonzero mean nor alignment with return principal components, which instead depends on the research process's design distribution and its relation to returns.
